takeaway.title: Seedance vs MiniMax H3: Summary Recommendation
takeaway.description: Tailor your selection to whether your priority is raw prompt nuance or full multimodal control:
points: Select MiniMax Hailuo H3 if you need short (6s) cinematic shots with hyper-realistic human facial expressions, natural liquid/fabric physics, and intricate prompt obedience.
Select ByteDance Seedance 2.5 if you need extended 15–30s storytelling, 3D greybox structural scaffolding, multiple reference images, or video-to-video editing workflows.

faq.title: Seedance vs MiniMax H3 FAQ
faq.description: Frequently asked questions regarding MiniMax Hailuo H3 and ByteDance Seedance models.

items.question: What is MiniMax H3 (Hailuo Video-01)?
items.answer: MiniMax Video-01 (often called Hailuo AI or H3 in community forums) is a high-performance foundation video model developed by MiniMax, celebrated for extraordinary prompt adherence and physical realism in 6-second clips.

items.question: Can MiniMax generate videos longer than 6 seconds?
items.answer: Currently, MiniMax Video-01 renders in 6-second passes at 25 fps. To create longer stories, creators must generate multiple clips and edit them in post-production. Seedance 2.5 supports up to 30s single-pass generation.

items.question: Which model is better for text-to-video prompt following?
items.answer: MiniMax Video-01 is widely recognized as one of the best models for pure text-to-video semantic fidelity, accurately capturing subtle adverbs, lighting descriptors, and multi-part actions without reference images.

items.question: How does MiniMax H3 vs Seedance (Seedance 2.0 vs MiniMax H3 or MiniMax H3 vs Seedance 2.5) compare?
items.answer: In head-to-head comparisons of MiniMax H3 vs Seedance 2.0, MiniMax H3 delivers slightly superior skin realism and prompt nuances in 6s takes. When comparing MiniMax H3 vs Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.5 pulls ahead for production teams requiring 30-second continuous scenes, synchronized audio effects, and 3D clay blockout controls.

items.question: How much does a 15 second Seedance video cost vs MiniMax H3 on fal (Hailuo 03 price vs Seedance 2)?
items.answer: When calculating how much does a 15 second Seedance video cost vs MiniMax H3 on fal (or Hailuo 03 price vs Seedance 2), Seedance 2.0/2.5 costs approximately $0.45–$0.90 for a 15-second sequence, while generating the equivalent length on MiniMax H3 requires three 6s passes (~$0.72) plus editing overhead.
